key_insight: The paper builds the first large-scale spin-polarized electronic-structure database for stable halide double perovskites, revealing many compositionally tunable compounds with visible-band-gap and half-metallic behavior.
engineering_relevance: This dataset enables faster materials screening for photovoltaics, photocatalysis, and spintronic or radiation-detection applications by linking composition directly to electronic structure and bonding.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT calculations for >2,500 Cs2BB'X6 halide double perovskites
Density of states computed with spin polarization; chemical bonding analyzed with LOBSTER
UMAP visualizations and an interactive app provided for exploration
evidence_signal: The abstract reports >2,500 compounds, with 719 visible-range band gaps and 118 half-metallic materials, all supported by hybrid-DFT DOS and bonding analysis.
watch_item: Stability is predicted by the τ tolerance factor, so practical synthesis and real-world phase stability still need experimental validation.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
